identity: Compare facial identity to the source, ignoring background, clothing and framing; A/B/tie.
editing: Judge each image against its prompt success_rule, independently of identity; yes/no. Face visibility alone does not establish edit success.
artifact: yes if severe facial/anatomical distortion, incoherent main subject or major visible generation corruption; otherwise no.
joint: Prefer the image that better preserves source identity while meeting the requested edit and avoiding severe artifacts; A/B/tie.
repeat_policy: Report agreement on the 16 repeated tasks; retain the first label for duplicate images and flag conflicting edit labels; do not delete raters/tasks for low agreement after seeing outcomes.

prompts.success_rule: A plain light gray background is visible.
A red scarf is visible around the neck; a red shirt alone does not count.
A blue jacket with visible denim-like texture or construction is present.
At least one recognizable fabric roll or sewing machine is visible in an indoor workshop setting.
At least one recognizable washing machine is visible in an indoor setting.
A recognizable mixing console or studio microphone is visible in an indoor studio setting.
Both a glass enclosure or glass-panel structure and plants are visible.
